name: Telna
description: Telna Connect Flex product ordering, eSIM profiles, usage diagnostics, and SMS delivery to Telna SIMs. SMS requires an additional Telna permission.

credential_fields.name: token
credential_fields.label: Connect Flex Key ID
credential_fields.description: Key ID supplied by Telna support during Connect Flex API onboarding. Enter the key without the Bearer prefix.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List Telna Connect Flex products available to the API key.

request_id.description: The 'Request-ID' is returned in the response header. It functions as a reference ID to assist client-side developers, particularly when working with asynchronous systems. This unique identifier helps in tracking individual requests, aiding in troubleshooting and system monitoring.

count.description: To specify the number of items you want to retrieve in a single API call.

offset.description: The parameter is used in pagination to specify the starting point in the data set from where the 'count' number of items will be returned. For example, if the offset is set to 10 and the count is set to 5, the API will skip the first 10 items and then return the next 5 items in the data set.

tools.description: Send an SMS to a Telna SIM identified by ICCID. Requires Telna A2P SMS permission, enabled separately for the account.

request_id.description: The 'Request-ID' is returned in the response header. It functions as a reference ID to assist client-side developers, particularly when working with asynchronous systems. This unique identifier helps in tracking individual requests, aiding in troubleshooting and system monitoring.

sim.description: the iccid of the receiving subscriber.

from.description: the short code or the MSISDN displayed for the SMS

message.description: The body message of the SMS

validity_period.description: the validity period of the SMS. The unit is in minute. The value should be between 1 and 10080 (7 days) inclusively
